package courseplannotification

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

type teacherStub struct{ teacher domain.PersonalTeacher }

func (stub teacherStub) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	return stub.teacher, nil
}

type storeStub struct {
	notification domain.CoursePlanNotification
	deliveredID  string
	accepted     bool
}

func (stub *storeStub) Accept(_ context.Context, notification domain.CoursePlanNotification) (domain.CoursePlanNotification, bool, error) {
	if stub.accepted {
		return stub.notification, false, nil
	}
	stub.accepted = true
	stub.notification = notification
	return notification, true, nil
}

func (stub *storeStub) MarkDelivered(_ context.Context, _ string, messageID string, deliveredAt time.Time) error {
	stub.deliveredID = messageID
	stub.notification.DialogMessageID = messageID
	stub.notification.DeliveredAt = &deliveredAt
	return nil
}

type dialogStub struct {
	binding        domain.TeacherDialogBinding
	idempotencyKey string
	body           string
}

func (stub *dialogStub) AppendTeacherProactive(_ context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, idempotencyKey, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	stub.binding, stub.idempotencyKey, stub.body = binding, idempotencyKey, body
	return domain.DialogMessage{ID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"}, nil
}

type clockStub struct{ now time.Time }

func (stub clockStub) Now() time.Time { return stub.now }

func planOutcome(source string) domain.CoursePlanOutcome {
	return domain.CoursePlanOutcome{
		EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", EventType: domain.SubjectCoursePlanCompleted,
		RequestID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CausationID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
		Status: domain.CoursePlanStatusCompleted, ResultCode: "COURSE_ASSIGNED",
		CourseID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Source: source, Reason: "INITIAL",
		AuditRefs: domain.CoursePlanAuditRefs{DialogID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"},
	}
}

func TestHandlerDurablyAcceptsThenDeliversTeacherOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	store, dialogs := &storeStub{}, &dialogStub{}
	handler := Handler{
		Teachers: teacherStub{teacher: domain.PersonalTeacher{
			ID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", StudentID: planOutcome(domain.CoursePlanSourceTeacher).StudentID,
			Language: "ru",
		}},
		Store: store, Dialogs: dialogs, Clock: clockStub{now: time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 12, 1, 0, 0, time.UTC)},
	}
	processed, err := handler.Handle(context.Background(), planOutcome(domain.CoursePlanSourceTeacher))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.Contains(t, dialogs.body, "Учебный план готов")
	require.Equal(t, planOutcome(domain.CoursePlanSourceTeacher).EventID, dialogs.idempotencyKey)
	require.Equal(t, "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", dialogs.binding.ID)
	require.Equal(t, "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", store.deliveredID)
}

func TestHandlerIgnoresStudentOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	processed, err := (Handler{}).Handle(context.Background(), planOutcome(domain.CoursePlanSourceStudent))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.False(t, processed)
}

func TestHandlerAcceptsTeacherOutcomeWithoutDialogAndDoesNotDeliver(t *testing.T) {
	store, dialogs := &storeStub{}, &dialogStub{}
	outcome := planOutcome(domain.CoursePlanSourceTeacher)
	outcome.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	outcome.AuditRefs = domain.CoursePlanAuditRefs{}
	handler := Handler{
		Teachers: teacherStub{teacher: domain.PersonalTeacher{
			ID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", StudentID: outcome.StudentID, Language: "en",
		}},
		Store: store, Dialogs: dialogs, Clock: clockStub{now: time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 12, 1, 0, 0, time.UTC)},
	}
	processed, err := handler.Handle(context.Background(), outcome)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.Empty(t, dialogs.idempotencyKey)
	require.Empty(t, store.deliveredID)
	require.Equal(t, outcome.EventID, store.notification.Outcome.EventID)
}

func TestHandlerDuplicateDeliveryUsesDurableInboxAndDoesNotAppendTwice(t *testing.T) {
	store, dialogs := &storeStub{}, &dialogStub{}
	outcome := planOutcome(domain.CoursePlanSourceTeacher)
	outcome.LearningPathID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	handler := Handler{
		Teachers: teacherStub{teacher: domain.PersonalTeacher{
			ID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", StudentID: outcome.StudentID, Language: "en",
		}},
		Store: store, Dialogs: dialogs, Clock: clockStub{now: time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 12, 1, 0, 0, time.UTC)},
	}
	processed, err := handler.Handle(context.Background(), outcome)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	firstKey := dialogs.idempotencyKey
	processed, err = handler.Handle(context.Background(), outcome)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.False(t, processed)
	require.Equal(t, firstKey, dialogs.idempotencyKey)
	require.Equal(t, "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", store.deliveredID)
	require.Empty(t, store.notification.Outcome.LearningPathID)
}
